articles.title: An orbiting disco ball gave Einstein’s theory its most precise test yet
articles.summary: Albert Einstein’s general theory of relativity predicts that a rotating mass like the Earth pulls the fabric of space and time around with it in a perpetual swirl. This phenomenon is known as frame dragging or the Lense-Thirring effect, after the two physicists who modeled it back in 1918. Frame dragging becomes more significant with larger masses and faster rotation, so we’ve mainly observed it around huge black holes. Measuring how much the Earth twists spacetime as it rotates has been much more challenging because our pale blue dot of a planet is millions of times lighter than a typical black hole and rotates rather slowly. articles.title: 微軟打造AI視覺化中介語言Flint，以語意規格簡化圖表生成
articles.summary: 微軟研究院發布開源視覺化中介語言Flint，讓AI代理程式以可由人員直接修改的規格描述圖表，再由編譯器自動補齊日期解析、座標軸、色階、標籤與版面配置等細節。Flint目前能將同一份規格轉換為Vega-Lite、Apache ECharts或Chart.js格式，降低AI直接產生完整圖表規格時容易出錯及難以維護的問題。
